title: Live hook test sometimes misses the worker addition
what: plugins/core/tests/hooks-live.test.sh case "sdd:worker gets the project's worker addition at its start" reported NONE in one full bin/ci run and passed in two later runs. Find the cause (shared state, timing, the live session not starting sdd:worker, output form) before more runs.
why: A full paid gate goes red for no change of its own (23 Oct: a rules-only branch, 1 of 3 runs red), so a merge waits on a re-run and its cause is unknown.
failing_case: 23 Oct, wt/structured-reword at a6e379d, full bin/ci: hook-tests step "FAIL sdd:worker gets the project's worker addition at its start: NONE" (.ci/steps/hook-tests.log:785); re-runs of hooks-live.test.sh in that worktree and in wt/guard-batch passed.
pass_cases: hooks-live.test.sh passes max(20, ceil(3/p)) clean runs in a row once the cause is fixed (rules/quality-gate.md).
